# Cat and Granny Online

> Play Cat and Granny online for free in the browser: a first-person cat game in
> which you wreck Granny's house, pin the mess on the newly adopted black cat and
> hide in a box before Granny spots you. No download, no account, no install.

Cat and Granny is developed by Mirra Games and distributed through Playgama. This
site is an unofficial fan page that embeds the official web build (Unity WebGL,
~43 MB, streamed from the publisher's CDN) and publishes written guides. It does
not host or modify the game files.

## Play

- [Play Cat and Granny](https://catandgranny.github.io/) — the game loads in the
  page. Keyboard: W A S D to move, mouse to look, Space to jump, F to interact,
  Q to hide in a box.

## Guides

- [How to Play](https://catandgranny.github.io/how-to-play/) — the objective, how
  the blame system works, when to hide and the mistakes that end a run.
- [Controls](https://catandgranny.github.io/controls/) — every desktop binding
  plus the touch layout on phones and tablets.
- [Tips & Tricks](https://catandgranny.github.io/tips/) — reading Granny's
  patrol, timing pranks around the black cat and getting more from the shop.
- [Unblocked](https://catandgranny.github.io/unblocked/) — running the game on
  school or work networks, and fixing a player that stays black.

## Facts

- Game: Cat and Granny, free, browser-based, Unity WebGL, rated E10+.
- Studio: Mirra Games. Distribution: Playgama.
- Genres: first-person action, stealth, simulation, cats.
- Platforms: any modern desktop browser; Android and iOS in the app stores.
- Cost: free, no account. The build carries the publisher's ads.
